package.name: g1_voice
package.description: G1 voice interaction: audio_backend (standalone Unix socket RPC to the G1 VUI/AudioClient service and its rt/audio_msg ASR stream), audio_bridge_node (ROS 2 topics for TTS, PCM playback, volume, LED, ASR), mic_node (raw 16 kHz microphone multicast stream with RMS utterance segmentation), and dialog_node (Ollama or OpenAI reply generation feeding the onboard TTS).
